title: US Navy 3D prints combat-ready drones and 1,000+ parts aboard aircraft carrier during exercise — containerized factory fabricated 80-mph FPVs and critical spares despite rough seas and 12-foot waves
title_bn: US Navy 3D prints combat-ready drones and 1,000+ parts aboard aircraft carrier during exercise — containerized factory fabricated 80-mph FPVs and critical spares despite rough seas and 12-foot waves
author: TechPulse
excerpt: During a two-week journey to Hawaii, a containerized factory aboard the USS Essex 3D-printed a dozen flight-ready drones, as well as over 1,000 parts including vital spares for Apache helicopters.
paragraph1: During a two-week transit to RIMPAC 2026 in Hawaii, a containerized factory aboard the USS Essex 3D printed a dozen flight-ready drones, as well as over 1,000 parts including vital spares for Apache helicopters. 3D Printing Industry reports that this was the first maritime run of the xCell expeditionary manufacturing platform from Firestorm Labs. Furthermore, production wasn’t halted by the rough seas and up to 12 ft waves endured during the journey.Big maritime milestone: xCell just proved expeditionary manufacturing works in real conditions.Firestorm's xCell platform printed 1,000+ parts, including 12 Squall FPV drones, en route to RIMPAC in Hawaii, as part of @NPS_Monterey CAMRE's distributed advanced manufacturing… pic.twitter.
paragraph2: com/2jZEi3m4TIAugust 5, 2026In Firestorm’s words, this additive manufacturing milestone using the xCell platform “just proved expeditionary manufacturing works in real conditions.” The 3D printers on board produced a plethora of useful things during the journey, on demand.xCell’s containerized production line takes up just two expandable 20-foot ISO containers, or a single 40-foot equivalent. Inside are industrial HP Multi Jet Fusion polymer printers alongside semi-automated assembly stations.Our headlining pick from the range of products that were manufactured at sea was the twelve quadcopter drones. These were Squall FPV drones, one of Firestorm Labs’ key products.
paragraph3: The NDAA-compliant Squall is designed for U.S. forces to “Print. Build. Fly. Dominate.
paragraph4: ”Squall has a range of up to 20 miles, a flight time of up to 42 minutes, a top speed of 80 mph, and can carry a 5.5-pound payload. These same drones were flown as adversary aircraft in a counter-UAS exercise when the USS Essex arrived at RIMPAC.Drones might be the most newsworthy output from xCell, but other essentials that the crew printed en route to Hawaii included printed Apache helicopter rotor droop‑stops, designed to prevent $500,000 rotor damage during at‑sea operations. Another spare part highlighted by the source that was needed during the exercises was a 3D-printed custom vacuum‑hose coupling for life preserver testing.Making up the 1,000+ 3D-printed parts and spares were crew-requested gadgets and gizmos like covers for electrical fittings, a bracket for mounting Starlink, gauges for checking deck tie-downs, and lots more.
paragraph5: “Every part xCell printed on deck is one that doesn't need to be flown or shipped across contested waters — cutting the fuel, aircraft hours, and personnel it takes to keep a ship operational,” boasted Firestorm on social media. “Repairs that once meant days or weeks waiting on a resupply run can now happen in hours, on station.”Get Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox. He enjoys covering the full breadth of PC tech; from business and semiconductor design to products approaching the edge of reason.

title: From Yulu To Discovered Materials — Indian Startups Raised $140 Mn This Week
title_bn: From Yulu To Discovered Materials — Indian Startups Raised $140 Mn This Week
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Indian startup funding activity remained muted in the second week of August, even as astrology platform AstroTalk joined the unicorn…
paragraph1: SUMMARYIndian startups raised $139.5 Mn between Aug 10 to 14, marking a 44% decline from $247.4 Mn raised in the preceding week. Cleantech led India’s startup funding activity at a sectoral level for the second consecutive week, at the behest of Yulu’s $93 Mn raise. Lightspeed India Partners, Finvolve and Peak XV Partners emerged as the most active investors this week, backing two startups apiece. Indian startup funding activity remained muted in the second week of August, even as astrology platform AstroTalk joined the unicorn club to become India’s 133rd unicorn. Between August 10 and 14, twelve startups raised a combined $139.5 Mn, marking a 44% decline from the $274.4 Mn raised by 22 startups in the previous week. The week’s funding activity was largely driven by Yulu’s $93 Mn Series C round, which accounted for a significant share of the total capital raised in the week leading up to India’s Independence Day on August 15. paragraph2: The round alone accounted for nearly 67% of the $139.5 Mn investment netted by Indian startups this week. Fintech followed as the second-most funded sector, with startups raising $29 Mn, led by wealthtech platform Centricity’s $29 Mn round. Advanced hardware and technology recorded the highest deal activity, with three funding rounds across segments including semiconductors and defence tech. Startups in the sector raised a combined $9.2 Mn during the week. Lightspeed India Partners, Finvolve and Peak XV Partners emerged as the most active investors this week, backing two startups apiece. Early-stage funding also picked up pace. Five seed stage startups raised around $14 Mn during the week, an 82% increase from the $7.7 Mn raised across five deals in the previous week. Meanwhile, Delhi NCR-based astrology platform AstroTalk entered India’s unicorn club at a valuation exceeding $1 Bn valuation. The valuation was attained at the behest of an ESOP buyback transaction, Inc42 learnt. Startup Fund Updates Of The Week Mirae Asset Venture Investments India marked the first close of its ₹1,800 Cr fund at ₹1,125 Cr.
paragraph3: The fund will back Series B to Series D startups across consumer tech, AI, SaaS, deeptech, advanced manufacturing and consumer discretionary. Accel has raised $550 Mn for its ninth India-focused fund as it looks to ramp up investments in AI, deeptech and other emerging sectors. AUM Ventures marked the first close of its ₹750 Cr India Innovation Fund at ₹225 Cr. The fund will invest primarily at the pre-seed and seed stages across deeptech and frontier technology startups. Bluehill.VC marked the final close of its maiden ₹400 Cr frontier tech fund, including a ₹50 Cr greenshoe option. Startup M&A Updates Of The Week Spacetech startup GalaxEye has acquired Bengaluru-based spacecraft engineering startup StarOps to strengthen its in-house satellite engineering and development capabilities. Healthtech startup Redcliffe Labs has completed the acquisition of Pune-based diagnostics chain Megavision Diagnostics Centre in a deal valued at around ₹40 Cr. Startup IPO Developments This Week Shares of LEAP India made D-Street debut at ₹166 apiece, a 4.4% premium to the IPO price of ₹159. The company’s IPO was oversubscribed 8.38X, receiving bids for 96.32 Cr shares against 11.
paragraph4: 49 Cr shares on offer. Shiprocket’s ₹1,617.5 Cr IPO received overwhelming investor interest, closing with an oversubscription of 99.38X. The company’s listing is tentatively scheduled for August 19. Table Space filed its DRHP with SEBI for an IPO comprising a fresh issue of shares worth up to ₹800 Cr and an offer-for-sale (OFS) of up to 6.55 Cr equity shares. Fintech unicorn Navi is reportedly planning to file its DRHP for an IPO as early as December, with the proposed issue estimated at around ₹3,000 Cr. Building materials unicorn Infra.Market is exploring a reverse-listing on the bourses via Shalimar Paints. The listed paints company is considering acquiring equity shares and CCPS of Infra.Market’s parent Hella Infra Market through a proposed share swap. B2B manufacturing startup Zetwerk filed its updated DRHP (UDRHP) with SEBI for its proposed IPO.
paragraph5: The issue comprises a fresh share sale of ₹2,600 Cr and an OFS of up to 9.6 Cr equity shares. Other Developments Of The Week Tiger Global Management has exited digital entertainment startup The Viral Fever (TVF) in a deal valuing the company at $22 Mn, down 73% from its peak valuation of $82 Mn in 2019. Listed traveltech company ixigo is set to sell a 17.39% stake in electric intercity bus startup Fresh Bus to Twelve Stone LLP for ₹36.6 Cr. Its stake will fall from 25.66% to 8.27%. Inc42 has learnt that former Dyson India MD Ankit Jain is building a stealth-mode premium consumer appliances startup, which has raised pre-seed funding from Singapore-based BEENEXT. Besides, AI health companion startup August AI is also in talks to raise around $4 Mn from VC firm Peak XV Partners. Stepping up investments in US-based AI startups, VC firm Peak XV Partners led a $45 Mn Series B funding round of San Francisco-based AI code testing startup Blacksmith.

title: Should You Buy an iPhone 17 Now or Wait for iPhone 18?
title_bn: Should You Buy an iPhone 17 Now or Wait for iPhone 18?
author: TechPulse
excerpt: For the first time since Apple started selling standard and "Pro" iPhones, we're not going to get an entry-level iPhone model this fall. Apple doesn't plan to release an iPhone 18 in September, and will only launch the iPhone 18 Pro, ‌iPhone 18 Pro‌
paragraph1: Friday August 14, 2026 12:15 pm PDT by Juli CloverFor the first time since Apple started selling standard and "Pro" iPhones, we're not going to get an entry-level iPhone model this fall. Apple doesn't plan to release an iPhone 18 in September, and will only launch the iPhone 18 Pro, ‌iPhone 18 Pro‌ Max, and foldable iPhone Ultra. The lower-cost ‌iPhone 18‌ won't come out until spring 2027. title: Pixel Journal gets some handy upgrades, and may soon tidy up your rambling entries
title_bn: Pixel Journal gets some handy upgrades, and may soon tidy up your rambling entries
author: TechPulse
excerpt: As Google rolls out some useful additions, we spotted evidence of on an AI-powered Auto format feature in the works.
paragraph1: C. Scott Brown / Android AuthorityTL;DR Pixel Journal is rolling out customizable reminders, media layouts, safer deletion, and support for Health Connect sleep data. Google also appears to be developing an AI-powered Auto format feature to clean up journal entries after you write or dictate them. Our teardown found evidence of Simple and Expressive formatting modes, each with a minimum word count before Auto format can be used. Pixel Journal is still a fairly young addition to Google’s Pixel lineup, and the company doesn’t seem finished tinkering with it yet. A new version of the app is now rolling out with several useful quality-of-life upgrades. But there are also clues under the hood suggesting that there’s nore to come, as we’ve uncovered signs of a feature that Google appears to be preparing for a future Pixel Journal release.You’re reading an Authority Insights story. Authority Insights brings you all the latest exclusive reports, app teardowns, leaks, and in-depth tech coverage from the Android Authority team that you won’t find anywhere else.
paragraph2: The latest Pixel Journal version brings some changes that will already look familiar if you caught our March teardown of the app. At the time, we spotted customizable reminder times and new Compact and Full layouts for photos and videos, although both features were still in development. They’re now available to all app users.The reminder controls let you choose whether Pixel Journal nudges you in the morning, afternoon, or evening, with the app showing approximate times of 7 AM, 2 PM, and 9 PM. Meanwhile, the media setting lets you switch between a Compact arrangement that groups images together and a Full layout that gives individual photos and videos more space. Those two additions are both handy, so it’s good to see our earlier findings make it across the finish line. You can see how they look in the images above.There are also a couple of changes we hadn’t previously spotted. The first adds some much-needed friction when deleting an entry.
paragraph3: Pixel Journal currently deletes an entry immediately after you tap Delete, with no confirmation and no way back. The updated behavior first asks you to confirm the deletion, then offers a brief Undo option for about five to ten seconds afterward. Given the sort of stuff people are likely to keep in a journal, that extra safety net seems overdue. The images below show how the new setup looks in the app.Pixel Journal is also expanding the Health Connect data it can use for personalized writing inspiration. The app can already make use of activity information, such as exercise and other physical activity, and it will now ask for permission to read sleep data as well. Health Connect treats Activity and Sleep as separate data categories, so granting access to one doesn’t automatically grant Journal access to the other.If you allow the new permission, Pixel Journal could use your sleep information alongside the other data it already has access to when suggesting things to write about. It might be an indicator of my age, but how well I slept is certainly a topic I often touch on when adding to my diary, so it makes sense for Pixel Journal to at least offer the option to include this data.
paragraph4: Auto format feature in the worksRyan Haines / Android AuthorityThe features above are rolling out, but we’ve also found evidence of an AI-powered Auto format feature in the works that could clean up your journal entries. Strings in the app refer to a feature called “Auto format,” and more strings add extra clues about how it may work. Here are the strings we found: Auto format Once you’re done speaking or typing, auto format can clean up your entry Expressive Simple You need to write at least {count} words to auto format an entry in expressive mode. You need to write at least {count} words to auto format an entry in simple mode. The second of those strings suggests AI will step up after you’ve completed an entry to tidy up what you’ve written or dictated, and there also appear to be at least two ways of doing that: “Simple” and “Expressive.” Google hasn’t spelled out what separates the modes yet, but the names give us a reasonable idea. Simple could stick more closely to your original wording while cleaning up the structure or presentation, whereas Expressive may take a little more freedom and artistic license with how the entry looks.Another pair of strings says you’ll need to write a minimum number of words before Auto format works, with separate thresholds mentioned for Simple and Expressive modes. We don’t yet know what those minimums are.
paragraph5: One possible reason for the restriction is that the AI may need sufficient context to meaningfully reorganize or polish an entry without hallucinating or trying to add a heap of flourish to a one-line entry, but that’s speculation at this point.Which feature do Google Pixel phones need to improve most?675 votesWhile there’s no guarantee that this feature will eventually make a stable release, the strings are a pretty strong indication that Google is looking at ways to let AI do more than simply inspire your next Pixel Journal entry. Given that journaling is often something you dash out at the end of the day before bed, letting the app tidy up the entry for you seems like a sensible addition.⚠️ An APK teardown helps predict features that may arrive on a service in the future based on work-in-progress code. However, it is possible that such predicted features may not make it to a public release.FollowThank you for being part of our community. Read our Comment Policy before posting.

title: Exclusive-Apple trains its own AI model for China market with Alibabas support, sources say
title_bn: এক্সিলেন্সিভ-অ্যাপল আলিবাবার সহায়তায় চীনের বাজারের জন্য নিজস্ব এআই মডেল প্রশিক্ষণ দিচ্ছে, সূত্র বলছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: APPLE-ALIBABA-AI:Exclusive-Apple trains its own AI model for China market with Alibaba's support, sources say
paragraph1: Aug 14 - Apple has trained a large language model specifically for the China market, three people familiar with the matter said, a departure from the iPhone maker's strategy of relying on third-party models to power AI features in the country.The AI model was developed in partnership with Alibaba Group and trained with the Chinese tech giant's support, the people said, declining to be named as the information is sensitive and not public.Apple's training of its own China-specific model has not been reported before. The company had previously leaned towards domestic partners' models to bring generative AI to iPhones and other devices sold in China, where U.S. models such as Anthropic's Claude and OpenAI's ChatGPT, which Apple pairs with its own technology in its home market, are not available.
paragraph2: Apple and Alibaba did not respond to requests for comment.Apple Intelligence, the company's suite of AI tools, is expected to launch in China in the coming months after an update to its iOS operating system, the people said.A China-tailored model of its own would give Apple greater control over the AI experience in its most competitive overseas market, where it has lost ground to local rivals including Huawei that have raced ahead with AI-equipped handsets.Apple's planned rollout represents a unique dual-track strategy on AI deployment for a foreign firm in China, which would allow it to navigate steep regulatory hurdles that have limited access for many other U.S. technology firms.
paragraph3: It would also make Apple the first foreign company approved by Beijing to offer a proprietary AI model in China, marking a rare collaboration by U.S. and Chinese tech firms amid a widening trade and diplomatic rift between the two countries over AI.REGULATORY HURDLES CLEARED BUT UNCERTAINTY REMAINSThe move follows a lengthy regulatory process that ended last month, when the Cyberspace Administration of China, the country's internet watchdog, registered Apple's generative AI service, clearing the way for Apple Intelligence to reach Chinese iPhones for the first time.Under that arrangement, Alibaba's Qwen model is to be incorporated into the version of Apple Intelligence that ships with compatible iPhone, iPad, Mac and Vision Pro models in China, and the service was also set to incorporate technology from Baidu, Reuters reported in July.Last week, Apple published a Chinese-language guide explaining how eligible Mac users in mainland China could connect Qwen to its Siri digital assistant and Writing Tools feature, a Mac-specific arrangement that could help it compete in China's AI PC market.
paragraph4: Apple has since deleted the guide, without providing an explanation.Alibaba's U.S.-listed shares climbed about 4% in premarket trading on news of the July registration, underscoring investor expectations that the tie-up could reshape China's AI ecosystem.PLE LOOKS TO AI FOR BOOST IN CHINAApple's partnership with Alibaba was first confirmed in February 2025, when Alibaba chairman Joe Tsai, speaking at the World Governments Summit in Dubai, said Apple would use the Chinese company's AI to power its phones in China."They talked to a number of companies in China.
paragraph5: In the end they chose to do business with us," Tsai said at the time. The rollout was subsequently delayed as Apple worked to adapt its features to Chinese regulations.China remains critical to Apple's fortunes, accounting for a significant share of its revenue. The absence of AI features on Chinese iPhones had been cited as a factor weighing on sales as consumers gravitated toward domestic brands offering built-in AI assistants.It was not immediately clear what role Apple's self-trained model would play alongside third-party Chinese models and how those are working together.This article was generated from an automated news agency feed without modifications to text.
bangla_paragraph1: ১৪ আগস্ট - অ্যাপল চীনের বাজারের জন্য বিশেষভাবে একটি বড় ভাষা মডেল প্রশিক্ষণ দিয়েছে, বিষয়টি সম্পর্কে পরিচিত তিনজন ব্যক্তি বলেছেন, আইফোন নির্মাতার কৌশল থেকে একটি বিদায় যা দেশে এআই বৈশিষ্ট্যগুলি চালিত করতে তৃতীয় পক্ষের মডেলগুলির উপর নির্ভর করে। এআই মডেলটি আলিবাবা গ্রুপের সাথে অংশীদারিত্বের মাধ্যমে বিকাশ করা হয়েছিল এবং চীনা প্রযুক্তি জায়ান্টের সহায়তায় প্রশিক্ষণ দেওয়া হয়েছিল, লোকেরা বলেছিল, নাম প্রকাশ করতে অস্বীকার করে কারণ তথ্যটি সংবেদনশীল এবং প্রকাশ্য নয়। অ্যাপলের নিজস্ব চীন-নির্দিষ্ট মডেলের প্রশিক্ষণ এখনও প্রকাশিত হয়নি
bangla_paragraph2: অ্যাপল এবং আলিবাবা মন্তব্যের অনুরোধে সাড়া দেয়নি। অ্যাপল ইন্টেলিজেন্স, কোম্পানির এআই সরঞ্জামগুলির স্যুট, আইওএস অপারেটিং সিস্টেমের আপডেটের পরে আগামী কয়েক মাসে চীনে চালু হবে বলে আশা করা হচ্ছে। চীনের নিজস্ব মডেল অ্যাপলকে তার সবচেয়ে প্রতিযোগিতামূলক বিদেশী বাজারে এআই অভিজ্ঞতার উপর আরও বেশি নিয়ন্ত্রণ দেবে, যেখানে এটি হুয়াওয়ে সহ স্থানীয় প্রতিযোগীদের কাছে মাটি হারিয়েছে যারা এআই-সজ্জিত হ্যান্ডসেটগুলির সাথে এগিয়ে গেছে। অ্যাপলের পরিকল্পিত রোলআউট একটি অজানা প্রতিনিধিত্ব করে।
bangla_paragraph3: এটি অ্যাপলকে চীনে একটি মালিকানাধীন এআই মডেল সরবরাহের জন্য বেইজিং কর্তৃক অনুমোদিত প্রথম বিদেশী সংস্থাও করে তুলবে। এটি এআই-র উপর দুই দেশের মধ্যে বাণিজ্য ও কূটনৈতিক বিভাজনের মধ্যে মার্কিন যুক্তরাষ্ট্র এবং চীনা প্রযুক্তি সংস্থাগুলির বিরল সহযোগিতা চিহ্নিত করবে। নিয়ন্ত্রক বাধা সরানো হয়েছে কিন্তু অনিশ্চয়তা অব্যাহত রয়েছে। এই পদক্ষেপটি দীর্ঘমেয়াদী নিয়ন্ত্রন প্রক্রিয়া অনুসরণ করে যা গত মাসে শেষ হয়েছিল, যখন চীনের সাইবারস্পেস প্রশাসন, দেশের ইন্টারনেট নজরদারি সংস্থা, অ্যাপলের জেনারেটিভ এআই পরিষেবা নিবন্ধিত করে,
bangla_paragraph4: অ্যাপল তখন থেকে কোনও ব্যাখ্যা না দিয়ে গাইডটি মুছে ফেলেছে।আলিবাবার মার্কিন তালিকাভুক্ত শেয়ারগুলি জুলাইয়ের নিবন্ধীকরণের খবরে প্রিমার্কেট ট্রেডিংয়ে প্রায় 4% বৃদ্ধি পেয়েছে, বিনিয়োগকারীদের প্রত্যাশাকে জোর দিয়ে যে এই টায়-আপ চীনের এআই বাস্তুতন্ত্রকে নতুনভাবে রূপ দিতে পারে।
bangla_paragraph5: অবশেষে তারা আমাদের সাথে ব্যবসা করার সিদ্ধান্ত নিয়েছে", তসাই তখন বলেছিলেন। অ্যাপল চীনা বিধিবিধানের সাথে তার বৈশিষ্ট্যগুলি খাপ খাইয়ে নেওয়ার জন্য কাজ করার কারণে পরে রোলআউটটি বিলম্বিত হয়েছিল। চীন অ্যাপলের ভাগ্যকে গুরুত্বপূর্ণ হিসাবে রয়ে গেছে, এর আয়ের উল্লেখযোগ্য অংশের জন্য দায়ী। চীনা আইফোনে এআই বৈশিষ্ট্যগুলির অনুপস্থিতি বিক্রয়কে প্রভাবিত করার কারণ হিসাবে উল্লেখ করা হয়েছিল কারণ গ্রাহকরা অন্তর্নির্মিত এআই সহকারী সরবরাহকারী দেশীয় ব্র্যান্ডগুলির দিকে আকৃষ্ট হয়েছিল। অ্যাপলের স্ব-প্রশিক্ষিত মডেলটি কী ভূমিকা পালন করবে তা অবিলম্বে স্পষ্ট ছিল না।

title: Razorpay’s ChatGPT Gambit, Snapchat’s Next Big Quest & More
title_bn: রেজারপেই'র চ্যাট জিপিটি গ্যাম্বিট, স্ন্যাপচ্যাট'র নেক্সট বিগ কোয়েস্ট এবং আরও অনেক কিছু
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Razorpay Wants To Put Indian Brands Inside ChatGPT As ChatGPT and other AI assistants move from answering questions to recommending…
paragraph1: Razorpay Wants To Put Indian Brands Inside ChatGPT As ChatGPT and other AI assistants move from answering questions to recommending products and facilitating purchases, Indian payments companies are racing to build the scaffolding for this new commerce layer. Razorpay is betting on this shift and ChatGPT commerce as the next big battleground. What’s The Plan? The fintech giant is working with OpenAI and NPCI to help merchants create ChatGPT-native storefronts, sync product catalogues and enable checkout using UPI capabilities such as UPI Circle and UPI Reserve Pay. It is working with around 50 brands and several ecommerce marketplaces experimenting with agentic commerce. The company claims its technology can reduce the time required for a Shopify merchant to set up a ChatGPT storefront from 10 weeks to around 30 minutes. What’s In It For Merchants? With traditional digital acquisition getting expensive, AI commerce offers merchants a potential new route to access customers. Razorpay is using that pull to bring merchants onto its AI stack. However, the bigger bet is building a broader commerce infrastructure layer across AI agents and platforms. The challenge for now is figuring out how Razorpay eventually makes money from it.
paragraph2: There’s A Catch? Consumers may be comfortable asking ChatGPT what to buy, but handing an AI assistant the power to complete a transaction is a different proposition. This is where Razorpay is seeing an opportunity. The company says its architecture keeps payment credentials away from AI models and requires user consent, but winning that trust at scale could determine how quickly agentic commerce takes off. As of now, it appears that ChatGPT is unlikely to replace ecommerce apps and marketplaces anytime soon. However, it could very well become a new layer for product discovery and shopping. Amid the current scheme of things, will Indian consumers trust AI assistants enough to make purchases through them? While that is a story for another day, here’s all about Razorpay’s ChatGPT commerce bet… From The Editor’s Desk 🎮 Nazara’s Bluetile Battle Nazara is acquiring Bluetile and BestPlay for $303 Mn, with $214 Mn still due by April 2027 as the company prepares for a CEO transition. The deal comes as Nazara invests across multiple studios, while Bluetile prioritises revenue growth and user acquisition over near-term profitability. Investors now face three key questions: how Nazara funds the remaining payout, whether Bluetile can expand margins, and when the broader portfolio generates meaningful cash. 📈 Honasa Posts A Bumper Q1 Mamaearth parent’s Q1 FY27 profit more than doubled to ₹90.
paragraph3: 5 Cr, while revenue rose 27% YoY to ₹755.9 Cr, marking its strongest quarter yet. Growth was broad-based, with focus categories up over 35%, younger brands growing more than 40%, and The Derma Co crossing a ₹1,000 Cr annualised sales run rate. Honasa is doubling down on its “House of Brands” strategy, expanding offline distribution and acquiring newer brands to reduce dependence on Mamaearth. 🔔 Zetwerk Inches Closer To IPO The B2B manufacturing giant has filed its updated DRHP with SEBI for a public issue, which will comprise a fresh issue of shares worth ₹2,600 Cr and an OFS component of 9.6 Cr equity shares. Founded in 2018, Zetwerk operates a full-stack manufacturing platform catering to clients across sectors such as industrial components, electronics and consumer hardware. It claims to operate 20 facilities globally and has raised $700 Mn to date. The startup’s revenue from operations zoomed 40% YoY to ₹15,900 Cr in FY26, while net losses soared 333% YoY to 1,606.1 Cr. Losses widened due to ₹1,250 Cr provision related to the discontinued civil infrastructure business and other accounting charges.
paragraph4: 👻 Snapchat’s Next Big Quest Snapchat is moving beyond Gen Z discovery, aiming to influence purchase consideration as users increasingly seek friends’ opinions and social validation before buying. Snap’s India advertiser base has grown sharply, but the bigger challenge is converting that expansion into meaningful, measurable and repeatable advertising revenue. AI, performance advertising and Chat are becoming key growth levers, but Snap must prove they deliver stronger conversions, efficiency and ROI. 📊 Awfis Profit More Than Doubles Awfis’ Q1 FY27 profit jumped 140% YoY to ₹24 Cr, while revenue grew 27% to ₹424.9 Cr as EBITDA rose 28%. The coworking firm added seven centres and 5,000+ seats, taking its network to 251 centres and 170K seats across 18 cities. GCC demand and Awfis Transform are emerging as key growth drivers, with 100+ GCC clients contributing 24% of rental revenue and Transform winning ₹200 Cr+ mandates. Inc42 Markets RECOMMENDED FOR yOU Inc42 Startup Spotlight Inside Carvve’s Tech-Led Marketplace For Car Accessories India’s car accessories market is fragmented, crowded and often difficult to trust. Owners face inconsistent product quality, unclear pricing, weak warranties and inconvenient workshop visits. Carvve is trying to solve this problem with its one-stop-shop car platform. An Integrated Experience: Born in Delhi’s Karol Bagh accessories market, Carvve is building a curated online marketplace for car upgrades.
paragraph5: Customers can browse interior, exterior, audio, electronics and performance products, select accessories suited to their vehicle and book installation at home or at a workshop of their choice. Visualising The Upgrade: A key part of Carvve’s tech stack is its 3D visualisation layer. Before buying, users can preview how an accessory may look on their car, understand the total cost and review installation details. This is designed to make a traditionally offline process more transparent and reduce uncertainty around fit, appearance and pricing. More Than A Marketplace: Carvve is positioning itself as an integrated experience rather than a product catalogue. Its services include professional doorstep installation, warranty-backed offerings, and post-installation support. It is eyeing a piece of the Indian automotive aftermarket, which is projected to become a $22.6 Bn opportunity by 2033. As car owners seek personalisation and convenience, can Carvve upgrade India’s informal car accessories market into a tech-savvy experience? bangla_paragraph1: রেজারপেই চায় যে ভারতীয় ব্র্যান্ডগুলি চ্যাটজিপিটির ভিতরে রাখুক যেহেতু চ্যাট জিপিটি এবং অন্যান্য এআই সহকারীরা প্রশ্নের উত্তর থেকে পণ্যগুলির প্রস্তাব এবং ক্রয়গুলি সহজতর করার দিকে চলেছে, ভারতীয় পেমেন্ট সংস্থাগুলি এই নতুন বাণিজ্য স্তরের জন্য স্কেলফোল্ডিং তৈরির জন্য দৌড়াদৌড়ি করছে। রেজারপে এই পরিবর্তন এবং চ্যাটজিরপিটি বাণিজ্যকে পরবর্তী বড় যুদ্ধক্ষেত্র হিসাবে বাজি ধরেছে। পরিকল্পনা কী? ফিনটেক জায়ান্ট ওপেনএআই এবং এনপিসিআইয়ের সাথে কাজ করছে যাতে ব্যবসায়ীরা চ্যাটজিবিটি-নেটিভ স্টোরফ্রন্ট তৈরি করতে, পণ্য ক্যাটালগগুলি সিঙ্ক করতে এবং সক্ষম করতে সহায়তা করে।
bangla_paragraph2: এই অ্যাপ্লিকেশনটি একটি নতুন প্রযুক্তির সাথে যুক্ত। এটি একটি নতুন অ্যাপ্লিকেশনের সাথে যুক্ত, যা গ্রাহকদের কাছে তাদের গ্রাহকদের জন্য একটি নতুন বিকল্প তৈরি করতে পারে। এটির সাথে একটি নতুন বৈশিষ্ট্য রয়েছে যা গ্রাহকরা চ্যাটজিপিটিকে জিজ্ঞাসা করতে স্বাচ্ছন্দ্য বোধ করতে পারে, তবে একটি এআই সহকারীকে লেনদেন সম্পূর্ণ করার ক্ষমতা দেওয়া একটি ভিন্ন প্রস্তাব। এখানেই রেজারপেই একটি সুযোগ দেখছে। সংস্থাটি বলেছে যে এর আর্কিটেকচারটি এআই মডেলগুলি থেকে অর্থ প্রদানের শংসাপত্রগুলি দূরে রাখে এবং ব্যবহারকারীর সম্মতি প্রয়োজন, তবে স্কেলটিতে সেই বিশ্বাস অর্জন করা কত দ্রুত এজেন্টিক বাণিজ্য উড়ে যায় তা নির্ধারণ করতে পারে । এখন পর্যন্ত দেখা যাচ্ছে যে চ্যাট জিপিটি ইকমার্স অ্যাপ্লিকেেশন এবং মার্কেটপ্লেসগুলি প্রতিস্থাপন করার সম্ভাবনা কম
bangla_paragraph3: হোনাসা তার হাউস অফ ব্র্যান্ডস কৌশল দ্বিগুণ করছে, অফলাইন বিতরণ সম্প্রসারণ করছে এবং মাদারথের উপর নির্ভরতা হ্রাস করার জন্য নতুন ব্র্যান্ড অর্জন করছে।  জেটওয়ার্ক ইঞ্চি আইপিওর কাছাকাছি বি 2 বি উত্পাদন জায়ান্ট একটি পি  এর জন্য সেবিতে তার আপডেট ডিআরএইচপি ফাইল করেছে।
bangla_paragraph4: স্ন্যাপচ্যাট এর পরবর্তী বড় খোঁজ স্ন্য্যাপচ্যাট জেনারেশন জেড আবিষ্কারের বাইরে চলেছে, গ্রাহকরা ক্রমবর্ধমানভাবে বন্ধুদের মতামত এবং সামাজিক বৈধতা কেনার আগে ক্রয়ের বিবেচনাকে প্রভাবিত করার লক্ষ্যে। স্ন্যপচ্যাট ইন্ডিয়ার বিজ্ঞাপনদাতা বেস তীব্রভাবে বেড়েছে, তবে বৃহত্তর চ্যালেঞ্জটি এই সম্প্রসারণকে অর্থবহ, পরিমাপযোগ্য এবং পুনরাবৃত্তিযোগ্য বিজ্ঞাপন আয়ের রূপান্তর করা। এআই, পারফরম্যান্স বিজ্ঞাপন এবং চ্যাট মূল বৃদ্ধির লিভার হয়ে উঠছে তবে স্ন্যାପকে প্রমাণ করতে হবে যে তারা শক্তিশালী রূপান্তরকারী, দক্ষতা এবং একটি শক্তিশালী উত্পাদন সরবরাহ করে।
bangla_paragraph5: গ্রাহকরা অভ্যন্তর, বহি, অডিও, ইলেকট্রনিক্স এবং পারফরম্যান্স পণ্য ব্রাউজ করতে পারেন, তাদের গাড়ির জন্য উপযুক্ত আনুষাঙ্গিক নির্বাচন করতে পারেন এবং বাড়িতে বা তাদের পছন্দের কর্মশালায় ইনস্টলেশন বুক করতে পারেন। আপগ্রেডটি ভিজ্যুয়ালাইজ করাঃ কারভের প্রযুক্তি স্ট্যাকের একটি মূল অংশ হ'ল এর 3 ডি ভিজ্যୁয়ালাইজেশন স্তর। কেনার আগে ব্যবহারকারীরা তাদের গাড়িতে কীভাবে একটি আনুষঙ্গিক দেখতে পারে তা পূর্বরূপ দেখতে পারেন, মোট ব্যয় বুঝতে এবং ইনস্টল করার বিশদ পর্যালোচনা করতে পারেন । এটি একটি traditionalতিহ্যবাহী অফলাইন প্রক্রিয়াকে আরও স্বচ্ছ এবং হ্রাস করতে ডিজাইন করা হয়েছে

title: iPhone 18 Pro Max launching soon: Expected launch date, price, display, battery and specifications
title_bn: আইফোন ১৮ প্রো ম্যাক্স শীঘ্রই লঞ্চ হবেঃ প্রত্যাশিত লঞ্চের তারিখ, দাম, ডিসপ্লে, ব্যাটারি এবং স্পেসিফিকেশন
author: TechPulse
excerpt: The iPhone 18 Pro series is eagerly anticipated and could potentially debut on 9 September. It may feature new colors, an A20 Pro chipset, and improved camera capabilities,
paragraph1: The iPhone 18 Pro series is eagerly anticipated and could potentially debut on 9 September. It may feature new colors, an A20 Pro chipset, and improved camera capabilities,iPhone 18 Pro Max image created based on renders(AI generated image)The season of flagship phone launches is upon us. With the Google Pixel 11 series already unveiled, the next big phone launch on everyone's radar is the iPhone 18 Pro lineup. Apple is yet to confirm the official launch date for the iPhone 18 Pro series, but rumours have suggested almost everything that we could expect from the upcoming phones.iPhone 18 Pro expected launch date:Apple usually launches its products in the second week of September in the last few years. This year's leaks have suggested that the company could pick 9 September as the potential launch date, but we will have to wait for an official confirmation from the company for now.iPhone 18 Pro expected features:The iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max are expected to keep the same design language seen on the iPhone 17 series.
paragraph2: However, we could see four new colour variants for the iPhone 18 Pro lineup, including a Dark Cherry finish, along with Light Blue, Dark Gray and Silver.The flagship lineup is expected to run on the A20 Pro chipset, which is likely to be the first-ever chipset by the company to use TSMC's 2nm process.The move to a smaller manufacturing process is expected to bring up to 15% faster performance and 30% better efficiency compared to the last-gen processor.Apple is also reportedly planning to use Wafer-Level Multi-Chip Module packaging from TSMC to integrate RAM directly with the processor and help improve Apple Intelligence performance while freeing up space inside the phone.While the camera system could remain largely unchanged, the iPhone 18 Pro series could feature a variable aperture main camera, allowing users to manually control how much light reaches the sensor. Reports also suggest Apple is testing larger apertures for both the main and telephoto cameras to improve low-light photography and background separation.The iPhone 18 Pro Max is expected to get the biggest battery yet on an iPhone.
paragraph3: As per leaks, the US version of the iPhone 18 Pro Max could feature a battery capacity of over 5,000mAh.This, along with the more efficient processor and improved display technology, is expected to result in significantly longer battery life.Expected price:A recent report by IDC hinted that Apple could implement a price hike of as much as $200 for the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max. The report came shortly after Apple announced it was raising the prices of its iPads and MacBooks amid a memory chip crunch that has increased demand for the raw materials required to manufacture the devices.About the AuthorAman GuptaAman Gupta is a Digital Content Producer at LiveMint with over 3.5 years of experience covering the technology landscape. He specializes in artificial intelligence and consumer technology, reporting on everything from the ethical debates around AI models to shifts in the smartphone market.

bangla_paragraph2: তবে আমরা আইফোন ১৮ প্রো লাইনআপের জন্য চারটি নতুন রঙের রূপ দেখতে পাচ্ছি, যার মধ্যে হালকা নীল, গা dark় ধূসর এবং রৌপ্য সহ একটি ডার্ক চেরি ফিনিস রয়েছে। ফ্ল্যাগশিপ লাইনআপটি এ২০ প্রো চিপসেটে চলবে বলে আশা করা হচ্ছে, যা সম্ভবত টিএসএমসির ২ এনএম প্রক্রিয়া ব্যবহারকারী সংস্থার প্রথম চিপস্যাট হবে। একটি ছোট উত্পাদন প্রক্রিয়াতে সরানো শেষ প্রজন্মের প্রসেসরগুলির তুলনায় 15% দ্রুত পারফরম্যান্স এবং 30% উন্নত দক্ষতা আনবে বলে মনে করা হচ্ছে। অ্যাপলও ওয়া ব্যবহার করার পরিকল্পনা করছে বলে জানা গেছে।
bangla_paragraph3: লিক অনুযায়ী, আইফোন ১৮ প্রো ম্যাক্সের মার্কিন সংস্করণে ৫০০০ এমএএইচ এর বেশি ব্যাটারি ক্ষমতা থাকতে পারে। এটি, আরও দক্ষ প্রসেসর এবং উন্নত ডিসপ্লে প্রযুক্তির সাথে, ব্যাটারির আয়ু উল্লেখযোগ্যভাবে দীর্ঘতর হবে বলে আশা করা হচ্ছে। প্রত্যাশিত মূল্যঃআইডিসির সাম্প্রতিক একটি প্রতিবেদনে ইঙ্গিত দেওয়া হয়েছে যে অ্যাপল আইফোন 18 প্রো এবং আইফোন १८ প্রো মাক্সের জন্য ২০০ ডলার পর্যন্ত মূল্যবৃদ্ধি বাস্তবায়ন করতে পারে। অ্যাপল একটি স্মারকের মধ্যে আইপ্যাড এবং ম্যাকবুকের দাম বাড়ানোর ঘোষণা করার পরেই এই প্রতিবেদনটি এসেছে।

তাঁর রিপোর্টিং প্রথম হাতের পরীক্ষা, স্বাধীন বিশ্লেষণ এবং প্রযুক্তি কীভাবে প্রতিদিনের ব্যবহারকারীদের প্রভাবিত করে তার উপর ভিত্তি করে। তিনি ভারতীয় গণ যোগাযোগ ইনস্টিটিউট, দিল্লি থেকে রেডিও এবং টেলিভিশন সাংবাদিকতায় পিজি ডিপ্লোমা (২০২২ বর্ষের) অর্জন করেছেন।

title: WhatsApp is now using AI to catch scammers before they can trick you
title_bn: WhatsApp এখন আপনাকে প্রতারণা করার আগে প্রতারকদের ধরতে এআই ব্যবহার করছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: WhatsApp is introducing Scam Detection, an AI-powered feature to identify scams.
paragraph1: WhatsApp is introducing Scam Detection, an AI-powered feature to identify scams. A message can be pinned on WhatsApp for a maximum of 30 daysWhatsApp is looking to tackle the increasing number of scams on the platform by using the power of artificial intelligence. The company on Thursday announced a new experimental feature called Scam Detection that uses on-device AI models to flag suspicious conversations.“As scam tactics evolve, from impersonation to social engineering to AI-generated lures, we’re always evolving as well, so that our protections stay ahead of scammers while protecting people’s personal messages with end-to-end encryption,” Meta wrote in a blog post.As per the US FTC, via The Verge, WhatsApp was the second-highest source of fraud contact methods in 2025. It noted that of the $2.1 billion worth of scams perpetrated through social media, $4.25 billion belonged to WhatsApp alone.
paragraph2: How does Scam Alert on WhatsApp work?Once the feature has been turned on, WhatsApp downloads a machine learning model on the user's device. This model will then run inferences on the user's phone to identify if an incoming message from a non-contact matches known scam patterns.WhatsApp says this on-device AI model is trained on “patterns observed in scam conversations from reports that users have sent to us.”The model is said to perform probabilistic classification based on conversational structure and linguistic signals.If the model decides that the message is a likely attempt to scam users, it will start showing them a warning that will not be visible to the other person.Users will also have the option to either block the person, report them or continue the conversation. They can also mark the chat as trusted, and WhatsApp will remove the warning.
paragraph3: The company says Scam Alert will not flag that chat in the future.“If a user marks that they trust a chat, they can also opt in to share the last 5 messages received with WhatsApp to help improve the feature’s accuracy,” Meta noted.The social media behemoth also notes that no user data is automatically shared with Meta, WhatsApp or any other third party during this process.“All inference happens on-device and no message content leaves the user device for classification. The minimal telemetry needed to measure whether the feature is working,” Meta wrote.The company also added that Meta or WhatsApp will not deliver a specific model to a specific user and every model version will be published on a public transparency ledger. Meta has also committed to publishing its model weights so that independent security researchers can verify that these models have been built for scam detection only.About the AuthorAman GuptaAman Gupta is a Digital Content Producer at LiveMint with over 3.

bangla_paragraph1: হোয়াটসঅ্যাপ স্ক্যাম ডিটেকশন, একটি এআই-চালিত বৈশিষ্ট্য চালু করছে যা স্ক্যামগুলি সনাক্ত করতে সহায়তা করে। একটি বার্তা সর্বোচ্চ 30 দিনের জন্য হোয়াટসঅপে পিন করা যেতে পারে। হোয়াটের প্ল্যাটফর্মের ক্রমবর্ধমান সংখ্যক স্ক্যামের বিরুদ্ধে কৃত্রিম বুদ্ধিমত্তার শক্তি ব্যবহার করে কাজ করার চেষ্টা করছে। কোম্পানি বৃহস্পতিবার স্ক্যাম সনাক্তকরণ নামে একটি নতুন পরীক্ষামূলক বৈশিষ্ট্য ঘোষণা করেছে যা সন্দেহজনক কথোপকথন চিহ্নিত করতে ডিভাইসে এআই মডেলগুলি ব্যবহার করে।
bangla_paragraph2: WhatsApp এ স্ক্যাম সতর্কতা কীভাবে কাজ করে?এই বৈশিষ্ট্যটি চালু হয়ে গেলে, WhatsApp ব্যবহারকারীর ডিভাইসে একটি মেশিন লার্নিং মডেল ডাউনলোড করে। এই মডেলটি ব্যবহারকারির ফোনে অনুমান চালিয়ে দেবে যে কোনও যোগাযোগহীন থেকে আগত বার্তা পরিচিত স্ক্যাম প্যাটার্নগুলির সাথে মেলে কিনা।WhatsApp বলেছে যে এই ডিভাইসের এআই মডেল ব্যবহারকারীরা আমাদের কাছে পাঠানো রিপোর্ট থেকে স্ক্যাম কথোপকথনে পর্যবেক্ষণ করা প্যাট্রনের উপর প্রশিক্ষিত।
bangla_paragraph3: কোম্পানিটি বলেছে যে ভবিষ্যতে স্ক্যাম অ্যালার্ট সেই চ্যাটকে চিহ্নিত করবে না।যদি কোনও ব্যবহারকারী একটি চ্যাটে বিশ্বাস করেন তা চিহ্নিত করে, তবে তারা বৈশিষ্ট্যটির নির্ভুলতা উন্নত করতে সহায়তা করার জন্য হোয়াটসঅ্যাপের সাথে প্রাপ্ত শেষ 5 টি বার্তা ভাগ করার জন্যও বেছে নিতে পারেন।

author: TechPulse

paragraph1: Thursday August 13, 2026 4:58 pm PDT by Juli CloverWe're getting close to the launch of new iPhone 18 Pro models that will replace the iPhone 17 Pro models, so MacRumors videographer Dan Barbera decided to take a look back at the iPhone he's been using for close to 12 months. Subscribe to the MacRumors YouTube channel for more videos.Ceramic Shield 2 was the best iPhone upgrade this year. Apple said it's more resistant to scratches, and that turned out to be true. Dan goes caseless, and his ‌iPhone 17 Pro‌ has only faint scratches, while the 16 Pro was scratched after three weeks. The iPhone has also survived facedown drops with no damage, but there are a few chips in the aluminum along the edges.
paragraph2: There have been reports of the orange color fading over time, but Dan didn't see that with his device. Battery life was also a standout on the ‌iPhone 17 Pro‌. It's able to keep up with a full day of heavy use, which is normally only possible with the larger battery in the Pro Max iPhones. Dan swapped to the smaller ‌iPhone 17 Pro‌ over the 17 Pro Max because the battery lasted longer than the 16 Pro battery. Apple added vapor chamber cooling in the 17 Pro, and that kept the iPhone cooler than normal for most of the year. Dan said his iPhone is running hotter with minor dips in performance, probably because of the iOS 27 beta.
paragraph3: Running beta software can affect battery life and device performance. Rumors suggest the ‌iPhone 18 Pro‌ isn't going to be a huge upgrade over the ‌iPhone 17 Pro‌, and it's likely prices are going to go up. It's not the worst idea to buy an ‌iPhone 17 Pro‌ now instead of holding out for the ‌iPhone 18 Pro‌, especially if you have an older iPhone. title: One UI 9.5 shows up on a Galaxy phone before Samsung is even done with One UI 9

author: TechPulse
excerpt: We may not have to wait much longer for One UI 9.5 details.
paragraph1: Shimul Sood / Android AuthorityTL;DR A leaker has shared screenshots of One UI 9.5. The tipster claims that “Much has changed.” Samsung is currently busy preparing to roll out the stable version of One UI 9.0 to older Galaxy devices.
paragraph2: However, we know that the company is multitasking, working on One UI 9.5, which was spotted on a test server for the Galaxy S27 Ultra. While no information about the update has been revealed yet, we could start getting some details soon.Over on X (formerly Twitter), Fahad Ali Javed shared some screenshots in a social media post. The screenshots are of an early build of One UI 9.
paragraph3: 5 running on a Galaxy device.There’s not really much to see here in these two images. They simply serve as proof that the leaker managed to install the firmware. Unfortunately, the social media post is also devoid of any details.However, Javed does offer the teaser “Much has changed.

bangla_paragraph1: শিমুল সুদ / অ্যান্ড্রয়েড কর্তৃপক্ষ টিএল;ডিআর এক লিকার ওয়ান ইউআই ৯.৫ এর স্ক্রিনশট শেয়ার করেছে। টিপস্টার দাবি করেছেন যে অনেক কিছু বদলে গেছে। স্যামসাং বর্তমানে ওয়ান UI ৯.০ এর স্থিতিশীল সংস্করণ পুরানো গ্যালাক্সি ডিভাইসে চালু করার প্রস্তুতিতে ব্যস্ত।
bangla_paragraph2: তবে আমরা জানি যে সংস্থাটি মাল্টিটাস্কিং করছে, ওয়ান ইউআই ৯.৫ এ কাজ করছে, যা গ্যালাক্সি এস ২৭ আল্ট্রা এর জন্য একটি টেস্ট সার্ভারে দেখা গেছে। যদিও আপডেট সম্পর্কে এখনও কোনও তথ্য প্রকাশিত হয়নি, আমরা শীঘ্রই কিছু বিবরণ পেতে শুরু করতে পারি। এক্স (পূর্বে টুইটার) এ, ফাহাদ আলী জাভেদ একটি সামাজিক মিডিয়া পোস্টে কিছু স্ক্রিনশট শেয়ার করেছেন। স্ক্রীনশটগুলি ওয়ান UI ৯ এর একটি প্রাথমিক বিল্ডের।
bangla_paragraph3: এই দুটি ছবিতে আসলে খুব বেশি কিছু দেখা যায় না। তারা কেবল প্রমাণ হিসাবে কাজ করে যে লিকার ফার্মওয়্যার ইনস্টল করতে সক্ষম হয়েছিল। দুর্ভাগ্যক্রমে, সামাজিক যোগাযোগ মাধ্যমের পোস্টটিও কোনও বিবরণ ছাড়াই। যাইহোক, জাভেদ টিজারটি সরবরাহ করে  অনেক পরিবর্তন হয়েছে।
bangla_paragraph4: এই পরবর্তী আপডেটে ঠিক কী পরিবর্তন হয়েছে? দেখে মনে হচ্ছে আমাদের টিপস্টার আরও ভাগ করার জন্য প্রস্তুত না হওয়া পর্যন্ত অপেক্ষা করতে হবে। ওয়ান ইউআই 9.5 আগামী বছর গ্যালাক্সি এস 27 সিরিজের সাথে আত্মপ্রকাশ করবে বলে আশা করা হচ্ছে। যদি স্যামসাং তার স্বাভাবিক রিলিজ প্যাটার্নগুলিতে আটকে থাকে, তাহলে পরবর্তী গ্যাল্যাক্সি ফোনটি জানুয়ারি থেকে মার্চের মধ্যে কোথাও চালু করা উচিত।

title: Samsonite Zipprix FT Waypoint review: A smarter take on an everyday travel essential
title_bn: সামসোনাইট জিপপ্রিক্স এফটি ওয়েপয়েন্ট পর্যালোচনাঃ একটি স্মার্ট নিতে দৈনন্দিন ভ্রমণ অপরিহার্য
author: TechPulse
excerpt: The Samsonite Zipprix FT Waypoint combines built-in tracking with a clever flat-top opening to make travelling with luggage a little easier.
paragraph1: The Samsonite Zipprix FT Waypoint combines built-in tracking with a clever flat-top opening to make travelling with luggage a little easier.Samsonite Zipprix FT WaypointFor decades, your suitcase has remained largely the same. Sure, the materials have become lighter, the wheels have become smoother and the designs have gotten a lot more interesting, but the basic idea of a suitcase hasn't really changed. You pack your clothes, zip it up, check it in at the airport and hope it comes out on the other side.But here comes the Samsonite Zipprix FT Waypoint, which is trying to give you a way to keep track of where your luggage is without having to buy an AirTag or any other accessory.I spent some time with the Zipprix FT Waypoint to see whether these features actually make sense to a normal traveller or if they are just another way of adding "smart" features to a product that doesn't really need them.Design:At first glance, the Zipprix FT Waypoint looks like your conventional hard-shell suitcase. It has the familiar rectangular design, four wheels, a telescopic handle and a polycarbonate exterior.The suitcase is made from high-grade polycarbonate, and the overall construction feels premium as well.
paragraph2: Samsonite has also gone with a fairly understated design, with subtle two-tone detailing rather than trying to make the suitcase look overly futuristic just because it has a smart tracking system built into it.The version I reviewed was the 68cm model, which weighs 4.3kg and has a 76-litre storage capacity, expandable up to 92 litres. Samsonite is also offering a 10-year warranty for the suitcase.One of the most useful features of the Waypoint is its flat-top opening, which allows you to quickly access your belongings without having to lay the entire suitcase flat. There are also multiple pockets, cross ribbons and a divider pad to keep your belongings separated. The expandable middle compartment is particularly useful if you tend to return from trips with more stuff than you left with.I also like that this doesn't turn the suitcase into some complicated contraption. It still feels like a normal suitcase, just one that gives you a little more flexibility when you need to access your belongings.
paragraph3: The technology:Coming to the standout feature of the Zipprix FT Waypoint, the in-built tracking system. The process is fairly straightforward, as there is an integrated Waypoint smart tag on the right-hand corner of the suitcase.You have to press a black-coloured button on the tag for a few seconds before the luggage starts beeping to let you know the tracker is active. The connection process is also fairly simple. You just have to connect to the tracker via Apple's Find My or Google's Find Hub, which takes less than 5 minutes for most people.Once the connection is established, you do not need to worry about the luggage every time you are at the airport. You can just go to your phone to continuously keep tracking its location.Verdict:At around ₹17,700 for the 68cm version, the Samsonite Zipprix FT Waypoint is an expensive suitcase. There is no getting around that.
paragraph4:
But after spending time with it, I can understand what Samsonite is trying to do here.The Zipprix FT Waypoint doesn't reinvent the suitcase. But between the flat-top opening and built-in tracking, it does make a pretty good argument that luggage could be a little smarter than it has been for the last few decades.About the AuthorAman GuptaAman Gupta is a Digital Content Producer at LiveMint with over 3.5 years of experience covering the technology landscape. He specializes in artificial intelligence and consumer technology, reporting on everything from the ethical debates around AI models to shifts in the smartphone market.
His reporting is grounded in first-hand testing, independent analysis, and a focus on how technology impacts everyday users. He holds a PG Diploma in Radio and Television Journalism from the Indian Institute of Mass Communication, Delhi (Class of 2022).
Outside the newsroom, he spends his time reading biographies, hunting for the perfect coffee beans, or planning his next trip.

bangla_paragraph1: স্যামসোনাইট জিপপ্রিক্স এফটি ওয়েপয়েন্ট ব্যাগ নিয়ে ভ্রমণকে কিছুটা সহজ করার জন্য বিল্ট-ইন ট্র্যাকিংকে একটি স্মার্ট ফ্ল্যাট-টপ খোলার সাথে একত্রিত করে।স্যামসোনিট জিপপ্রিক্স এফটির ওয়েপেইন্ট কয়েক দশক ধরে, আপনার স্যুটকেস মূলত একই রকম রয়ে গেছে। অবশ্যই, উপকরণগুলি হালকা হয়ে উঠেছে, চাকাগুলি মসৃণ হয়ে উঠেছেন এবং ডিজাইনগুলি অনেক বেশি আকর্ষণীয় হয়ে উঠেছিল, তবে একটি স্যুইটের প্রাথমিক ধারণাটি সত্যই পরিবর্তিত হয়নি। আপনি আপনার কাপড় প্যাক করুন, এটি জিপ আপ করুন, বিমানবন্দরে এটি চেক ইন করুন এবং আশা করুন এটি ওটিতে আসে।
bangla_paragraph2: সামসোনাইট একটি স্মার্ট ট্র্যাকিং সিস্টেম অন্তর্নির্মিত আছে কারণ এটি খুব ভবিষ্যতবাদী চেহারা করার চেষ্টা করার পরিবর্তে একটি সুক্ষ্ম দুই-রঙের বিস্তারিত সঙ্গে একটি মোটামুটি সংযত নকশা সঙ্গে গিয়েছিলাম। আমি পর্যালোচনা সংস্করণ 68cm মডেল ছিল, যা 4.3kg ওজনের এবং 76 লিটার স্টোরেজ ক্ষমতা আছে, 92 লিটার পর্যন্ত প্রসারিত। সামসোনাাইট এছাড়াও স্যুটকেসের জন্য 10 বছরের ওয়ারেন্টি প্রদান করছে। ওয়েপয়েন্টের সবচেয়ে দরকারী বৈশিষ্ট্যগুলির মধ্যে একটি হল তার সমতল-শীর্ষ খোলার, যা আপনাকে দ্রুত
bangla_paragraph3: প্রযুক্তি:জিপপ্রিক্স এফটি ওয়েপয়েন্টের স্ট্যান্ডআউট বৈশিষ্ট্য, অন্তর্নির্মিত ট্র্যাকিং সিস্টেম। প্রক্রিয়াটি বেশ সহজ, কারণ স্যুটকেসের ডানদিকে কোণে একটি ইন্টিগ্রেটেড ওয়েপইন্ট স্মার্ট ট্যাগ রয়েছে। ট্র্যাকারটি সক্রিয় রয়েছে তা জানাতে ব্যাগটি বিপিং শুরু করার আগে আপনাকে কয়েক সেকেন্ডের জন্য ট্যাগের একটি কালো রঙের বোতাম টিপতে হবে। সংযোগ প্রক্রিয়াটিও বেশ সহজ। আপনাকে কেবল অ্যাপলের ফাইন্ড মাই বা গুগলের ফাইট হাবের মাধ্যমে ট্র্যাকারের সাথে সংযোগ করতে হবে,
bangla_paragraph4: কিন্তু এর সাথে সময় কাটানোর পরে, আমি বুঝতে পারি যে স্যামসোনাইট এখানে কী করার চেষ্টা করছে। জিপপ্রিক্স এফটি ওয়েপয়েন্ট স্যুটকেসকে পুনরায় আবিষ্কার করে না। তবে ফ্ল্যাট-টপ খোলার এবং অন্তর্নির্মিত ট্র্যাকিংয়ের মধ্যে, এটি একটি ভাল যুক্তি দেয় যে গত কয়েক দশকের তুলনায় ব্যাগটি কিছুটা স্মার্ট হতে পারে। লেখক সম্পর্কেআমন গুপ্তআমন গupta লাইভমিন্টের একটি ডিজিটাল সামগ্রী প্রযোজক, প্রযুক্তির ল্যান্ডস্কেপকে আচ্ছাদন করার জন্য ৩.৫ বছরেরও বেশি অভিজ্ঞতা রয়েছে। তিনি কৃত্রিম বুদ্ধিমত্তার বিশেষজ্ঞ
bangla_paragraph5: আপনি আমানকে লিঙ্কডইনে এবং এক্স এ খুঁজে পেতে পারেন, অথবা ইমেইলে যোগাযোগ করতে পারেন।

title: Google Search corrects results after prematurely declaring OpenAI CEO Sam Altman dead
title_bn: Google Search corrects results after prematurely declaring OpenAI CEO Sam Altman dead
author: TechPulse
excerpt: It appears that a fake Wikipedia page edit was all it took.
paragraph1: Joe Maring / Android AuthorityTL;DR Google Search was mistakenly telling users that Sam Altman had passed away. It appears that a vandalized Wikipedia page about Altman falsely declared that the CEO died on August 12, 2026. The page has since been fixed and a date of death is no longer appearing in Search. Everyone makes mistakes, right? However, some mistakes are more prominent than others, such as when Google Search missteps.
paragraph2: That happens to be the case today, as the search engine mistakenly informed users of surprising, false news about Sam Altman.Earlier today, Google Search users noticed something strange when looking up the OpenAI CEO. As usual, the results included the executive’s name, image, and a brief overview taken from Wikipedia. However, along with those details was a date of death. The card read that Altman had passed away on August 12, 2026.
paragraph3: Unsurprisingly, this left many confused, especially as no major outlet had reported the news. Sure enough, it turned out to be a mistake that wasn’t entirely Google’s fault. Rather, it appears that a vandalized Wikipedia page about Altman is to blame. Altman’s Wikipedia page was altered to declare the CEO as dead. Thanks for flagging – this is no longer appearing, and was not a manual change by Google.
paragraph4: When people vandalize public info sources, this can affect the information that appears in Search. pic.twitter.com/i5pBqTCjDS As you may or may not know, Google’s automated systems scrape information from sources, like Wikipedia, to fill out its search summaries. It appears that the latest scraping picked up on this false edit and displayed the date of death next to Altman’s summary.
paragraph5: It didn’t take long for Google to correct the error. In a social post, the company thanked users for flagging the issue. It appears that the Wikipedia page is now fixed, and Google confirms that the date of death is no longer appearing next to the CEO’s name.FollowThank you for being part of our community. title: Razer Naga V3 Pro Review: My new 23-button mouse
title_bn: Razer Naga V3 Pro Review: My new 23-button mouse
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Razer's Naga V3 Pro has the same form factor as its predecessor, but it features more buttons, an upgraded sensor and switches, and better battery life.
paragraph1: If you like the Naga V2 Pro, the V3 Pro is a solid upgrade — especially if you already have Razer's HyperPolling Wireless Dongle (or Mouse Dock Pro). Pros +More buttons +Comfortable +Nice switches (even if they're very similar to the Naga V2 Pro's) Cons --8,000 Hz polling rate only available with separate purchase -Overly-sensitive free-scroll mode -Too many options? Why you can trust Tom's Hardware Our expert reviewers spend hours testing and comparing products and services so you can choose the best for you. Find out more about how we test. If you know anything about me, you know I love a mouse with 19+ buttons. That's why I've been using Razer's Naga V2 Pro as my daily driver for the past three and a half years — and I have no regrets; it's on our list of best gaming mice for a reason. Thankfully, Razer must've heard my V2 Pro begging for its life, because there's a new multi-button MMO mouse in town with up to 23 programmable buttons: the Razer Naga V3 Pro.The Naga V3 Pro is very similar to its predecessor at a glance — because Razer hasn't changed the mouse's form factor at all. It still comes with three swappable magnetic side plates (in 2-, 6- and 12-button layouts), but that's where the similarities end. The new Naga V3 Pro sports Razer's latest Focus Pro 50K gen-3 optical sensor, which has a maximum sensitivity of 50,000 DPI and a maximum speed of 930 IPS, and can handle up to 90 G's of force. It's not cheap, as the Naga lineup never has been, with an MSRP of $180 — pricier than most premium flagship gaming mice because it is, after all, all about versatility.Design and ComfortLike some of Razer's other new mice, the Naga V3 Pro has the exact same shape as its predecessor — it's a shorter, wider mouse than most flagship premium mice, measuring 4.7 x 2.
paragraph2: 97 x 1.72 inches (119.5 x 75.5 x 43.5mm). It's still a larger mouse overall, just a different shape. It has a right-handed ergonomic shape with a contoured thumb area, with interchangeable plates and a curved ring finger rest on the right side. It has a matte black plastic shell and features three RGB light zones in the scroll wheel, the logo on the palm rest, and on the side panel. Image 1 of 4 (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) The mouse weighs slightly less than its predecessor: 3.9 ounces (112g) without the side plate or cable attached; the side plates weigh 20g (12-button), 17g (6-button), and 15g (2-button). The Naga V2 Pro weighed 134g regardless of the side plate. Its side plates — which are the same 12-button, 6-button, and 2-button layouts as the side plates from the Naga V2 Pro — now feature more durable double-shot molded keycaps, so they should last longer and the legends should remain crisp and readable throughout the mouse's lifetime (not that anyone is really looking at the legends on their mouse buttons). (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)The mouse has three buttons the Naga V2 Pro doesn't have — in addition to its primary left/right buttons, tilt wheel, two buttons above the tilt wheel, and profile switch on the bottom.
paragraph3: There are now two edge buttons on the left side of the left mouse button (set by default to scroll up and down through DPI steps) and the ring finger rest has also been turned into a button (set by default to activate Razer's HyperShift for multi-layer inputs). I didn't have any problems with accidentally pressing the ring finger rest button, but there is a locking switch that lets you quickly disable it (it actually stops it from clicking at all, which is nice) if you do have issues. Image 1 of 3 (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) The Naga V3 Pro has a multi-mode tilt wheel with three distinct modes: tactile, free-spin, and precision tactile. The scroll modes can be toggled off, but they aren't fully configurable like the customizable scroll feature in the Naga V2 Pro. This seems fine, though — the customizable scroll feature in the Naga V2 Pro seemed like overkill to implement with very minor benefits, and I prefer just a few distinct modes to something that you can fully customize.That said, I kind of wish the distinct modes had been slightly better implemented, as I found the free scroll to be especially over-sensitive — even just resting my finger next to the scroll wheel often caused it to activate. There's a setting in Synapse 4 that automatically switches over to free scroll mode when you're scrolling fast enough, but I didn't like this because there's an audible click every time it switches. The button directly next to the wheel is set to move through scroll modes by default, while the button above that is set to open up Razer's AI Prompt Master.Get Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox. (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)On the bottom of the mouse, you'll find a power switch, a programmable profile switch button, and the ring finger rest lock, as well as PTFE mouse feet and a dummy mouse puck that can be swapped in with charging pucks from Razer accessories. (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)In the box, the Naga V3 Pro comes with a 6-foot (1.8m) braided USB-C to USB-A cable, three interchangeable side plates, a USB-A dongle, and a USB-A to USB-C adapter. The cable is braided but it's fairly stiff — it's definitely not flexible or drag-free, like Razer's HyperFlux cables it usually bundles with its mice.
paragraph4: You can use it as a mouse cable, but you probably won't want to.Specs Swipe to scroll horizontally Sensor Model Razer Focus Pro 50K Gen-3 Max Sensitivity 50,000 DPI Max Speed (IPS) 930 IPS Max Acceleration 90 Gs Polling Rates Up to 8,000 Hz* Programmable Buttons Up to 23 LED Zones 3 Cable 6ft / 1.8m, detachable braided USB-C to USB-A Connectivity 2.4GHz wireless, Bluetooth, wired (USB-C) Measurements (L x W x H) 4.7 x 2.97 x 1.72 inches / 119.5 x 75.5 x 43.5 mm Weight (excluding cable) 3.9oz / 112g without side plate; side plates weigh 20g (12-button) / 17g (6-button) / 15g (2-button) MSRP / Price at Time of Review $179.99 Release Date Aug. 11, 2026 PerformanceThe Naga V3 Pro features Razer's latest Focus Pro 50K Gen-4 optical sensor, which has a maximum sensitivity of 50,000 DPI and a maximum speed of 930 IPS, and can handle up to 90 G's of force.
paragraph5: These are kind of crazy specs for a mouse considering most people won't use a DPI above 3,200 or so — what you need to know is that it's a great sensor that tracks across a variety of surfaces with excellent accuracy. It's speedy, too, though this is not the kind of mouse most people will be moving around lightning fast and picking up, as it's more than twice the weight of ultra-lightweight mice such as Razer's DeathAdder V4 Pro. (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)The mouse also features Razer's Gen-4 optical mouse switches, which are rated for up to 100 million clicks and offer crisp, tactile feedback. The feedback does feel slightly crisper and more deliberate than the switches in the Naga V2 Pro, but it's not a very significant difference and you definitely can't tell unless you're using both side-by-side. Still, at 100 million clicks they should last as long as the mouse does.These switches are only in the primary mouse buttons, not the side panel buttons — though the side panel buttons still felt fairly crisp and gave nice tactile feedback. The only buttons I didn't love on the Naga V3 Pro were the edge buttons on the left side of the left mouse button — they were a little too far to the left to be comfortable, and they had a very soft, mushy, lackluster click.The Naga V3 Pro ships with a 1,000 Hz polling rate and a 1,000 Hz polling rate is the highest you're going to get unless you make a separate purchase. The mouse is capable of getting up to an 8,000 Hz polling rate, but you'll need to purchase either Razer's Mouse Dock Pro or its HyperPolling Wireless Dongle in order to achieve polling rates higher than 1,000 Hz.

title: Uber surprised robotics company Serve by selling its entire stake
title_bn: Uber surprised robotics company Serve by selling its entire stake
author: TechPulse
excerpt: The divesture comes comes as the two once-tight companies have started to diverge on the business side.
paragraph1: Uber has sold off its entire stake in Serve Robotics, the autonomous delivery robot company that spun out of the ride-hailing company more than five years ago. Uber made the disclosure in a regulatory filing that was first reported by Bloomberg. Uber’s exit from Serve Robotics has been brewing for at least a year, according to regulatory filings that show the company reduced its stake in 2025. Still, the final selloff came as a surprise to Serve, which learned about it once it was officially disclosed, according to a source familiar with the events. paragraph2: Serve got its start as Postmates X, the robotics division of the on-demand delivery startup Postmates that Uber acquired in 2020 for $2.65 billion. A year later, the division spun out as an independent company called Serve Robotics, a name taken from the autonomous sidewalk delivery bot that was developed and piloted by Postmates X. Uber not only backed Serve, it also struck a partnership with the sidewalk delivery robot firm in 2022. The companies expanded that partnership in May 2023 to deploy up to 2,000 of Serve’s sidewalk bots onto Uber’s app in multiple markets in the United States. It seems that Uber started pulling back earlier this year, according to comments made earlier this week — and before Uber’s sold its shares — during Serve’s second-quarter earnings call.
paragraph3: “From the first quarter of 2022 through the first quarter of this year, delivery volume through Uber grew for 17 consecutive quarters. In Q2, that trend reversed for the first time. This was caused by lower-than-expected robot utilization,” Serve Robotics co-founder and CEO Ali Kashani said last week during the company’s second-quarter earnings call. Kashani said on the August 6 call that the companies have “differing views” about the operating model to scale its shared autonomous fleet, including in areas such as fleet coordination or merchant integration. He noted that during the same timeframe, Serve Robotics saw deliveries with another food delivery partner grow nearly 50% in a single quarter. As a result, Serve doesn’t expect that it would make sense to renew the partnership agreement with Uber when it expires in early 2027, Kashani said at the time.

title: Razer Naga V3 Pro mouse is a honed MMO weapon with 23 programmable buttons — more customizable controls and lighter weight come at the same price as its predecessor
title_bn: Razer Naga V3 Pro mouse is a honed MMO weapon with 23 programmable buttons — more customizable controls and lighter weight come at the same price as its predecessor
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Razer has launched the new Naga V3 Pro, marking the latest evolution in its renowned Naga series of MMO gaming mice. The new iteration offers 23 programmable buttons for maximum control and customization.
paragraph1: (Image credit: Razer) Razer has unveiled the Naga V3 Pro, the latest evolution of the brand's iconic Naga series of MMO gaming mice. Priced at $179.99, the Naga V3 Pro introduces several significant upgrades over its predecessor, including an improved sensor and switches, more buttons, and a lighter weight.Check out the Razer Naga V3 Pro on AmazonThe Naga V2 Pro has long stood as a consistent champion on our list of the best gaming mice, and it's earned its laurels as the best MMO gaming mouse. Building upon this strong foundation, the all-new Naga V3 Pro brings a host of new hardware improvements and user-focused features that will continue to set the bar for a gaming mouse designed for avid MMO fans.The Naga V3 Pro comes with up to 23 programmable buttons, or two more than the Naga V2 Pro, although one of those is on the base of the mouse and won't be accessible during gameplay. With the Naga V3 Pro, Razer has also transitioned to the company's Gen 4 optical mouse switches for the main buttons.
paragraph2: These are rated for over 100 million clicks, with a 12% lighter actuation force compared to the previous Gen 3 switches.The new iteration features a modular design that allows gamers to alternate between three swappable magnetic side plates. There is a 12-button side plate for MMOs and a six-button one for MOBAs or battle royale titles, as well as a simple two-button layout for the FPS genre. Despite featuring different hardware and more buttons, the Naga V3 Pro is up to 13% lighter than the Naga V2 Pro.On the inside, the Razer Naga V3 Pro features Razer’s flagship Focus Pro 50K (Gen-3) optical sensor. It is a substantial upgrade over the previous Focus Pro 30K (Gen-1) sensor found in the Naga V2 Pro. The Naga V3 Pro is not the first Razer mouse to incorporate the Focus Pro 50K sensor, though.
paragraph3: The Focus Pro 50K sensor also appears in the acclaimed Viper V4 Pro that came out several months ago. Nonetheless, the inclusion of the Focus Pro 50K on a Naga-series product is a major leap forward.As you can infer from the model name, the Focus Pro 50K has a maximum sensitivity of 50,000 DPI, a remarkable 67% increase over the already impressive Focus Pro 30K. The jump in DPI allows for more precise cursor movements. However, the improvements extend far beyond just raw sensitivity. One standout feature of the Focus Pro 50K is its DPI granularity: users can now make 1-DPI incremental adjustments, compared to the Focus Pro 30K, which only allowed adjustments in 50-DPI steps.In terms of other performance metrics, the Focus Pro 50K features a 930 IPS tracking speed and a 90 G acceleration rating, representing a 25% and 29% increase over the Focus Pro 30K, respectively.
paragraph4: These advancements mean the Focus Pro 50K is more agile, responsive, and more consistent in tracking compared to its predecessor.Get Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox. Image 1 of 4 (Image credit: Razer) As far as battery life goes on the Naga V3 Pro, gamers can expect up to 280 hours on Bluetooth or up to 155 hours on Razer's proprietary HyperSpeed Wireless 2.4 GHz connection technology. That means you can pair it with Razer's HyperFlux V2 wireless charging mouse pad or the Razer Mouse Dock Pro.The Naga V3 Pro launches with an MSRP of $179.99, the same MSRP as the previous Naga V2 Pro, despite the array of upgraded hardware.
paragraph5: The Naga V3 Pro is available on Amazon at the launch price and for purchase directly from Razer’s official online store. title: ChatGPT and Gemini both just passed 1 billion users
title_bn: ChatGPT and Gemini both just passed 1 billion users
author: TechPulse
excerpt: For the 14th time, a Google product has hit 1 billion users. Google CEO Sundar Pichai posted on X that a billion people are using Gemini every month, and that Gemini is Google's fastest-growing product ever. A billion users is a huge milestone, but G
paragraph1: For the 14th time, a Google product has hit 1 billion users. Google CEO Sundar Pichai posted on X that a billion people are using Gemini every month, and that Gemini is Google’s fastest-growing product ever.A billion users is a huge milestone, but Google isn’t the first AI app to hit it. OpenAI’s ChatGPT hit the mark a few weeks ago, though the company buried the announcement that “more than 1 billion people are putting ChatGPT to work” in an otherwise anodyne blog post about how people use AI. External data suggested ChatGPT crossed 1 billion users as early as this June, but OpenAI hadn’t announced anything until that post on August 6th.
paragraph2: OpenAI spokesperson Lindsay McCallum says ChatGPT crossed 1 billion monthly users some time ago, and hit a billion a week in July.The metrics, and the growth they represent, are somewhat complicated here. OpenAI said that ChatGPT had 900 million weekly active users in February of this year, and reaching 1 billion five months later represents a significant slowdown in growth for ChatGPT, which was for years touted as the fastest-growing software ever. McCallum declined to say how many monthly users ChatGPT has.Google, meanwhile, announced in February that Gemini had 750 million monthly users, before reporting 950 million in late July on its earnings call, and Google spokesperson Alex Joseph says it reached 1 billion last week before announcing it today.
paragraph3: (Claude appears to be growing fast, but Anthropic doesn’t disclose its user data, and estimates put its user numbers in the tens of millions.) There’s no easy way to compare weekly and monthly users, of course, but the simplest read is that ChatGPT is the larger of the platforms but Gemini may be the faster growing.These Google numbers, by the way, all appear to refer directly to the Gemini app itself, which would mean all the places Google has shoved Gemini into its other products don’t count. The Gemini that comes preinstalled on Android phones seemingly does, though, which is a huge win for Google — Gemini chief Josh Woodward posted that Gemini has more than 100 million active users on iOS, which would mean by extension that the vast majority of Gemini users are also Android users. You can see why OpenAI is so interested in building its own hardware.
paragraph4: The AI race in general has tightened significantly this year. Anthropic’s Claude Code became a phenomenon and forced OpenAI to catch up with Codex, while Google began integrating Gemini into seemingly every surface of its products. The companies’ models have consistently leapfrogged each other, and they’re all suddenly in a race with models coming out of China. But for a long time, ChatGPT was the de facto brand for AI chatbots, and while it’s still seemingly the most popular and well known of its kind, its once commanding lead appears to have largely evaporated. The race to a billion users is over — now these companies have to race to find things for those users to do, and ways to make money in the process.

title: FBI says cybercriminals are hacking into victims’ online accounts to steal their intimate pictures
title_bn: FBI says cybercriminals are hacking into victims’ online accounts to steal their intimate pictures
author: TechPulse
excerpt: In a new alert, the FBI said cybercriminals are targeting adults and minors in an attempt to steal their personal and intimate pictures in extortion campaigns.
paragraph1: In Brief Posted: 12:38 PM PDT · August 11, 2026 Image Credits:Matt Cardy / Getty Images The FBI is warning that cybercriminals are hacking into the social media accounts of adults and children to steal their intimate explicit images and videos. The perpetrators rely largely on social engineering tactics to target people, the alert said, and victims are often extorted, or their stolen content published online. “Victims often face re-victimization through harassment, sextortion, stalking or other targeted attacks, such as advertising stolen content on a victim’s own social media page,” the FBI wrote.
paragraph2: These types of crimes have been known for years. But the FBI’s public alert could indicate that these incidents are now on the rise, according to Rachel Tobac, the CEO of the security awareness training firm SocialProof Security. The FBI did not respond to TechCrunch’s request for comment.
paragraph3: Tobac said that these attacks especially target young boys, and that these attacks are “a big public health issue,” given that sometimes the victims are driven to self-harm in response. The FBI’s advisory said the attackers rely on brute-forcing accounts using leaked or previously used passwords, impersonating customer service representatives by pretending to work for Instagram and other social media companies, and contacting targets alleging that they need to recover their account. Some hackers use phishing emails that rely on fake domains that look like legitimate social media log-in pages.
paragraph4: To protect yourself, use unique passwords stored in a password manager, ensure multi-factor authentication is switched on, and be suspicious of anyone reaching out unprompted claiming to work for a social media company, as tech companies generally do not reach out to their customers. The advisory also urges people to avoid storing sensitive and intimate pictures in online accounts.

title: Apple Pay Chief Jennifer Bailey Retiring in October

author: TechPulse
excerpt: Apple Pay executive Jennifer Bailey is retiring and leaving Apple in October, reports Bloomberg. Bailey has been with Apple since 2003 and has long overseen ‌Apple Pay‌ and Apple Wallet. In an employee memo announcing her departure, Apple's services
paragraph1: Tuesday August 11, 2026 11:19 am PDT by Juli CloverApple Pay executive Jennifer Bailey is retiring and leaving Apple in October, reports Bloomberg. Bailey has been with Apple since 2003 and has long overseen ‌Apple Pay‌ and Apple Wallet. In an employee memo announcing her departure, Apple's services chief Eddy Cue said Bailey will be available in an advisory role. After more than 25 years at Apple, Jennifer Bailey has decided to retire in October. During her tenure, Jennifer has made extraordinary contributions from leading the Apple Store Online through a period of significant growth and global expansion to overseeing the launch of Apple Pay. Under Jennifer's leadership, Apple Pay has changed the way hundreds of millions of our users pay, with a simpler, more secure, and private experience.
paragraph2: She also led the development and growth of Apple Wallet, oversaw the development and launch of Apple Card, and led our work in Services fraud prevention and partner operations, Gift Cards, and Trust and Safety. And those are just a few of her achievements. On a personal note, Jennifer has been an incredible friend and leader, and I will miss working with her. Please join me in thanking Jennifer for her incredible contributions to Apple. Before Jennifer's transition at the end of October, we will announce our succession plan, and Jennifer will continue to be available to support the transition in an advisory role. As we continue to work toward our vision of replacing the physical wallet, I'm more confident than ever in the work that we are all doing and look forward to an exciting future ahead.
paragraph3: Bloomberg says Bailey's retirement is "seen as a major loss" for the company. ‌Apple Pay‌ has expanded to more than 80 countries under Bailey's leadership, and Apple says it is accepted at more than 85 percent of retailers in the United States. Bailey is one of several Apple leaders who have retired or are retiring in the near future. Apple general counsel Kate Adams is leaving Apple in late 2026, while environmental chief Lisa Jackson left in early 2026. AI chief John Giannandrea and COO Jeff Williams retired in 2026 and 2025, respectively, and UI design lead Alan Dye departed for Meta in late 2025. Apple CFO Luca Maestri and marketing chief Phil Schiller have taken on smaller roles, and CEO Tim Cook is set to transition to a new role on September 1.

title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT desktop app for Linux
title_bn: OpenAI launches ChatGPT desktop app for Linux
author: TechPulse
excerpt: OpenAI is finally bringing a dedicated ChatGPT desktop app to Linux operating systems.
paragraph1: In Brief Posted: 12:15 PM PDT · August 11, 2026 Image Credits:Olivier Morin/AFP / Getty Images ChatGPT is on desktops across the world, but there’s been one place where it’s been lacking: the Linux community. Certain sectors of the open source developer community have been clamoring for OpenAI to bring its chatbot to their neck of the woods.
